decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the selection focusing on durability and value for money. Among the full-sized backpacks, prod_backpacks_057 (QT&QY Military Tactical Backpack) is the strongest contender with a high 4.7-star rating and over 6,000 reviews, indicating consistent performance. It offers a large 45L capacity and robust features at a competitive price point. While the Maxpedition (prod_backpacks_038) is likely higher quality, its price is significantly higher. The slings (prod_backpacks_182 and prod_backpacks_168) were interesting for light travel, but the military tactical pack provides the most versatility for hiking and daily use.
